name: Vestrybook
tagline: The operating system for the modern congregation office.
positioning: Vestrybook consolidates membership records, giving statements, and volunteer scheduling into one governed system built for small church staffs.

hero.h1: Run the church office like the operation it actually is.
hero.sub: Vestrybook replaces the shared spreadsheet, the paper directory, and the year-end giving scramble with one auditable record your whole staff can trust.

features.title: Unified member ledger
features.description: Every household, contact, and sacramental record in one governed profile — no more reconciling three lists before a mailing goes out.

features.title: Giving statements on autopilot
features.description: Generate IRS-ready contribution statements in bulk, flag missing tax IDs, and email or print the entire batch in a single reviewed run.

features.title: Volunteer & rota scheduling
features.description: Fill nursery, greeter, and worship slots with conflict checks, auto-reminders, and a confirmation trail your coordinator can defend.

features.title: Role-based access control
features.description: Give the treasurer numbers, the pastor pastoral notes, and volunteers only their own schedule — with a full audit log on every field.

testimonials.quote: We closed our giving statements in one afternoon instead of the usual two weeks of cross-checking envelopes against the spreadsheet. Our treasurer nearly cried.
testimonials.name: Marissa Coleman

testimonials.quote: The access controls finally let me hand scheduling to a volunteer without exposing giving records. That separation alone was worth the switch.
testimonials.name: Daniel Whitfield

testimonials.quote: Onboarding took a morning. Vestrybook mapped our old membership export cleanly and flagged forty duplicate households we'd been mailing twice for years.
testimonials.name: Priya Nathan

pricing.blurb: For solo administrators running a single small congregation.
For multi-staff offices that need governance and audit trails.
For multi-site networks and denominational offices.

homepage.footerBlurb: Vestrybook is administrative software for congregations — built for the people who keep the office running, not just the platform.
